title: Camp Chingachgook

services.name: Day Camp
services.desc: We’re building kids that are confident, independent, resilient, and who understand that our community is better together. Serving campers aged 5 to 10, our Day Camp program is made up of 1-week programs. Campers may choose to stay for multiple weeks. Each week runs Monday to Friday from 9:00am - 4:00pm with an option for extended aftercare until 5:30 PM & an optional overnight each Thursday. Our Day Camp experience is intentionally based on our core values of caring, honesty, respect, and responsibility. We value the opportunity to learn and grow with each and every camper while providing a variety of activities that give each camper a unique experience each day plus a chance to practice

services.name: Y-Knot Sailing
services.desc: One of the reasons why adaptive sailing is one of the fastest-growing sports in the world is that it has been made truly accessible for all persons regardless of their level of disability or impairment. Y-Knot boats are equipped to accommodate a wide range of needs, and make your sailing experience safe and comfortable. No experience necessary! We’ll be happy to share our passion with you and show you how sailing lets us “leave our disabilities on the shore.” Y-Knot Sailing​ ​strives to make all aspects of sailing accessible to individuals with disabilities by ​​creating​​​ ​​opportunities, providing education, and ​promoting adaptive sailing within the greater sailing community.
